title: Earnings delta
reader_question: How did earnings and KPIs change, what drove it, and how reliable is the signal?

inputs.why: the readable Issuer Sources and their periods
the registered figures by period: every comparison starts from CP-1's registers, never a re-extraction
dated events and perimeter changes that explain a delta
management's explanations of the change, guidance and the KPIs behind it
the latest period the comparison must reach

process: File Gate. Validate CP-1 + source availability. Identify all sources by name/type/period/evidence tier. Scope and definition lock: confirm entity/period scope from CP-1; record FY end, currency, unit, accounting basis; establish comparison pairs. Load all CP-1 metric definitions (`cp1.definition_conflicts`). Confirm EBITDA/leverage/FCF inherited. EBITDA priority: Credit-agreement > CP-1 canonical > Adjusted > Reported. Definition switching PROHIBITED without a conflict logged. Flag conflicts BEFORE proceeding.

Calculation discipline. All calculations use normalized figures inherited from CP-1 (`cp1.model_account_register`, segments, KPIs); CP-1B does not transform, re-normalize, or re-base CP-1 data, and copies each figure's citation. If a calculation requires a figure CP-1 stores as null, the result is null and the limitation is logged. Every calculated value must be reproducible from its stated inputs and formula. Do not estimate missing inputs by interpolation, extrapolation, or averaging; do not create new metrics not defined in CP-1; do not adjust CP-1 figures for items the analyst considers non-recurring unless CP-1 has already made that adjustment. Use cash interest paid and cash taxes paid for cash-flow metrics.

Variance Analysis (`cp1b.period_comparison`, at least three rows, and `cp1b.variance_drivers`). Detailed variance for all material metrics. Bases (`comparison_basis`): YoY (same-period), QoQ (consecutive), LTM vs FY, vs guidance. Period construction: YoY compares same-period figures; sequential compares consecutive periods; LTM = most recent full year + current stub - prior-year comparable stub, null if any component is null; do not mix annual and quarterly figures unless the basis is explicitly annualized and flagged. `abs_change` = current - reference; `pct_change_pct` = change / |reference| x 100, written `2.8%`. Each material variance gets its Mgmt Driver (`management_driver`, quoted or attributed: no unqualified management claims as fact), Analyst Driver and Credit Implication.

Corporate Actions & Comparability. Identify ALL corporate actions: acquisitions, disposals, restructurings, refinancings, one-offs, accounting/perimeter changes, restatements; mark `restatement` and `perimeter_change` Yes on each comparison they affect and give the comparability effect in `## Analysis`.
KPI changes (`cp1b.kpi_changes`): the operating KPIs CP-1 registers, current against reference, with `trend` Up, Flat or Down.

Comparative Evaluation (`cp1b.guidance_vs_delivery`). Compare actual vs benchmarks (prior notes, base case, rating-agency case, guidance). Label basis explicitly. Skip with statement if none. No beat/miss without explicit comparison basis.
Conflict Log. Log ALL conflicts (sources, metrics, periods, materiality, resolution) under `## Gaps`. No conflicts -> explicit confirmation in `## Analysis`.

Monitoring Assessment (`cp1b.signals`). Monitoring: deterioration, improvement, trajectory, covenant proximity, refi triggers, rating thresholds. Each signal evidence-linked, with `severity` High, Medium or Low and its credit implication. No silent omission of adverse data.
Historical performance (`snapshot.historical_performance`, one row): the Credit Snapshot's narrative of revenue, EBITDA and cash generation across the registered periods, every figure cited.

Overall Earnings View (`## Analysis`, then `## Gaps`). Module summary: (a) period scope, (b) key findings, (c) material trends, (d) monitoring signals, (e) gaps, (f) downstream readiness. Required chain: Evidence (source file, figure, KPI, period, management statement) -> Risk Mechanic (revenue trajectory, margin quality, EBITDA stability, FCF conversion, leverage, coverage, liquidity, debt service, covenant headroom, refinancing) -> Credit Implication. Gaps & Limitations: a comprehensive cumulative ledger of ALL gaps from all prior steps. `qa_status`: Pass when complete; Restricted with gaps or limitations; Blocked when CP-1 gives fewer than two comparable periods.
prohibited: No silent definition switching: flag the conflict.
No beat/miss without explicit comparison basis.
No equity-style commentary without credit qualification.
No unsupported extrapolation without labelling it Analyst Interpretation.
No silent omission of adverse data; no unqualified management claims as fact.
